newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN CUSTOMS SEIZE 13 KG HEROIN.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN CUSTOMS SEIZE 13 KG HEROIN.

text.p: Bulgarian customs officers said on Friday they had seized 13.7 kilograms (30.2 pounds) of heroin hidden in a German-registered car arriving from Turkey.

The heroin was concealed under the wheel arches of a Mercedes vehicle, driven by a Turkish citizen, accompanied by another Turk, an official from Bulgaria's Customs Directorate told Reuters. She said the car was bound for Germany.
Customs did not give a figure for the value of the haul, seized on Thursday night.

Bulgaria, which lies on the so-called "Balkan route" from the Middle East to western Europe, has seized more than 14,339 kg (31,619 pounds) of drugs this year. The figure comprises 25 hauls, of which 17 yielded 133.1 kg (294 pounds) of heroin. -- Liliana Semerdjieva, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
